description: Light-DOM utility classes for application shell structure. Loaded via index.css under @layer utilities.layout. Apply to host elements and page-level structure — NOT inside component shadow roots. Covers: .grouped-component (fused control rows/columns), .sherpa-app-layout (full-page shell grid), .sherpa-main-content / .sherpa-view-header-group / .sherpa-main-content-slot (main area structure), .sherpa-scroll-under (sticky header with scroll shadow), .layout-grid-outlet (grid injection helper).

classes.name: grouped-component
classes.description: Fuses adjacent controls (buttons, inputs, custom elements) into a seamless inline row or column with a shared outer border. The wrapper owns border, border-radius, and overflow:hidden. Sets --_cg-border-width:0 and --_cg-border-radius:0 which inherit into child shadow DOMs — children become borderless and radiusless automatically. For grouping dashboard tiles use <sherpa-container-group> instead.

attributes.name: data-direction
attributes.description: Omit for horizontal row (default). Set to 'vertical' for a stacked column. Children get align-items:stretch.

cssProperties.name: --_cg-separator-color
cssProperties.description: Color of the divider lines between children. Automatically set to active color when a sherpa-button[data-active] child is present.

notes: The wrapper's :focus-within activates the border color automatically — no JS needed.
When a sherpa-button[data-active] child exists, the entire group border lifts to the active/brand color.
Children's border-radius and border-width are zeroed out via inherited custom properties — do not set them on children.

classes.name: sherpa-scroll-under
classes.description: Sticky header that gains a background and shadow when content scrolls beneath it. Works with CSS scroll-state() (Chrome/Edge/Safari 133+) automatically. Falls back to JS: set [data-scrolled] on the element via IntersectionObserver or scroll listener. The element must sit inside a container with container-type:scroll-state (or overflow-y:auto with that container wrapping it).

attributes.name: data-scrolled
attributes.description: JS fallback. Set this attribute when the scroll container has scrolled past 0. Remove when back at top. Only needed for Firefox (no scroll-state() support).

notes: Uses position:sticky + top:0 + z-index:20. Ensure parent has overflow-y:auto.
CSS-native activation: wrap content in a container with container-type:scroll-state; container-name:main-scroller.
The sherpa-app-shell component handles this automatically for its internal scroll area — only apply manually to custom shells.

classes.name: sherpa-app-layout
classes.description: Full-page CSS grid shell: fixed-width sidebar nav column + main content area. Use ONLY when NOT using the <sherpa-app-shell> web component — this class is the manual alternative for custom shells. <sherpa-app-shell> is strongly preferred.
notes: grid-template-columns: var(--nav-column-width, collapsed) 1fr. Nav column expands to 320px when sherpa-nav[data-pinned='true'] is present.
min-height:100vh; height:100vh — requires body to be flex with flex-direction:column (reset.css handles this).
Always prefer <sherpa-app-shell> over this class — the component manages nav pin state, product-bar slot, and keyboard navigation automatically.

classes.name: sherpa-main-content
classes.description: Main content column inside .sherpa-app-layout. Flex column, overflow:hidden, fills remaining height. Pair with .sherpa-view-header-group and .sherpa-main-content-slot for the canonical structure.

classes.name: sherpa-view-header-group
classes.description: Legacy wrapper for sherpa-view-header + optional global sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar at the top of .sherpa-main-content. Flex column, flex-shrink:0. Apply .sherpa-scroll-under alongside for sticky behaviour. (App Shell v2 uses sherpa-app-header instead — see the app-shell-v2 pattern.)

classes.name: sherpa-main-content-slot
classes.description: Scrollable main content viewport. flex:1, overflow:auto, container-type:scroll-state. Place sherpa-layout-grid directly inside — it receives width:100% and min-height:100% automatically.

classes.name: layout-grid-outlet
classes.description: display:contents wrapper for injecting children as direct grid items into a <sherpa-layout-grid>. Apply to a div that holds grid children so they participate in the 12-column grid as if the wrapper wasn't there.

notes: All classes live in @layer utilities.layout — they have low specificity and components always override them.
sherpa-app-layout, sherpa-main-content, sherpa-view-header-group, sherpa-main-content-slot, and sherpa-scroll-under are ONLY needed if you are building a manual shell without <sherpa-app-shell>.
In most cases use <sherpa-app-shell> with the nav, product-bar, and default slot — it handles all shell structure internally.
